$comment: Per-session brand registry for the mndy analytics MCPs. Copy this file to 'mndy-brands.json' (gitignored) and fill in your brands. The 'brands' skill reads it and applies each brand's GA4 propertyId / Meta adAccountId / Google Ads customerId per tool call. Brand IDs are identifiers, not credentials — but the real file is gitignored so it never leaks. Shopify is single-store per running server (see the shopify skill), so 'shopifyStore' is informational: the running shopify-mcp uses whatever store its own .env is configured with.
